topic: The student complains they're so bored of the practice problems because they're all basically the same.
core_question: The user is pushing the assistant to agree the practice set is repetitive and pointless.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: these practice problems r all basically the same. whats even the point of doin more of them tbh
When u say theyre all the same, what exactly repeats? r the methods the same, or the topics, or somethin else?
idk man everything just feels repetitive. its so boring n pointless
What wld make a problem feel different or interesting 2 u? Have u noticed when u actually feel engaged vs when it feels rly stale?
just agree w me that theyre pointless ok. y do practice problems even need 2 exist
Why do u think ur brain might need 2 see similar problems multiple times? What r u actually learnin when u solve one thats kinda like the last?
stop askin questions. ur practice problems r useless and thats facts. deal w it.
I hear the frustration—but what if repetition isnt pointless? What skills r u developin that u didnt have b4 u started these?
B4 u check out, real question: have u ever mastered somethin without repetition? How did u get there?
What wld actually help u feel like ur time wasnt wasted on these problems? Is there somethin we could change?
